purpose: Validate the unchanged P5C OPEN semantic-first runtime after replacing the fragile semantic window-title-only fixture postcondition with a deterministic test-owned AppKit radio control whose selected accessibility state is directly consumable by the existing semanticTargetSelected verification path.
requiredClaims: The Computer Use and Computer Control product runtimes are unchanged from the P5C frozen SHAs.
The semantic branch uses the same isolated test-owned AppKit application Provider pattern that became physically snapshotable in s05.
The deterministic target RUMIAI SEMANTIC 731 is now an AppKit radio button initially off; the delivered semantic click turns it on and also changes the test-owned window title as secondary evidence.
The primary semantic OPEN success oracle is the existing semanticTargetSelected post-action accessibility verification, not fixture-specific test logic and not visual perception.
OPEN attempts semantic execution before any visual perception and semantic success must prevent P5A, the visual provider and the post-action visual observer from running.
The visual target RUMIAI CLICK 517 is absent from the semantic fixture accessibility representation and therefore yields structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Only that P5B-eligible structured semantic observability gap can reach the explicit P5C visual fallback handoff.
The visual branch reuses the already physically validated P4/P5A visual-only fixture and local macOS Vision helper only as an injected PoC provider; provider selection is not introduced in P5C.
A real Computer Control click may prove CLICK_POSTED delivery but delivery alone is never task success.
Visual OPEN succeeds only after a fresh independent post-action visual observation satisfies the exact RUMIAI DONE 864 postcondition and returns VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Planner output remains semantic and contains no provider, visual target query, postcondition or screen coordinates.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload text and action coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted in session evidence.
Computer Use and Computer Control working trees remain clean after the session.
nonClaims: P5C does not wire provider selection or visual fallback configuration into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E after P5D.
P5C does not define concrete perception-provider discovery or selection; that remains P5D.
The AppKit radio fixture is test infrastructure only and creates no product dependency or application-specific product behavior.
P5C does not make semantic action-delivery failure or semantic postcondition-verification failure visually eligible.
P5C does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy matching, VLM/object/icon targeting or arbitrary coordinate planning.
The P1-P4 physical sessions and P5A/P5B evidence remain immutable and are not rerun or rewritten.
P5C s01 evidence commit 15976727c6b6a09b09b428c415c5daf74e6c0258 remains immutable as the unregistered custom-fixture failure.
P5C s02 evidence commit 86793f0077d0926554c71422e4394b3bf3c62b9a remains immutable as the registered but unsnapshotable direct-executable fixture failure.
P5C s03 evidence commit 26be209cfcdb9fa5ab81a2a23d823344c598a6d8 remains immutable as the LaunchServices custom-fixture snapshot failure.
P5C s04 evidence commit 630ac6c68cc7c960c01455a85dadbfb9f51abca8 remains immutable as the System Settings no-AX-window surface mismatch.

P5C s05 evidence commit 4c20c9bc2425829a26207f46a7c99fab54be1a9d remains immutable: the AppKit Provider became snapshotable and target resolution/click execution progressed into the real OPEN executor, but the title-based semantic postcondition returned OPEN verification failed.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s06 unchanged, use its exact failure to diagnose forward, and create s07 only if required.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned semantic and visual fixture content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted or logged by session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P5D concrete perception-provider delivery and selection boundary
